regions.today: Dry and sunny today. Very warm with highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees generally, though a little cooler near the east coast due to a moderate, occasionally fresh, easterly wind.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with mostly clear skies. Lowest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees with a mostly moderate easterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another dry day with plenty of sunshine. Very warm for many with highest temperatures of 22 to 25 degrees, though staying cooler in the east in a mostly moderate east to northeast wind.
